assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game reward item, the MIRACLE CUBE, the highest-tier mercenary summoning cube replacing an older premium cube. Create one exquisite closed cube on a genuinely transparent background, no text, no letters, no UI, no card or character. It must have a substantial clearly cubic silhouette shown from a fixed three-quarter view with top and two faces visible, centered, entirely inside the canvas with generous clear alpha margin for animation. Refined midnight obsidian glass panels, luminous pearl-white metal edges, restrained champagne-gold structural bevels, precise interlocking seams, intricate yet legible engraved contract seals. One small brilliant prismatic core visible behind the front crystalline window, with a warm white heart and restrained cyan/violet spectral refractions. Eight intentional armored corner locks and six separable face panels clearly show how this artifact can physically unfold. High-end Korean fantasy game inventory art, painterly luxury material finish, expertly rendered polished metal and translucent crystal, beautiful clean controlled highlights, deep dimensionality, very detailed at full size and recognizable at 64px. Strong shape and expensive craftsmanship, avoid generic wireframe cube, simple neon box, excessive floating ornaments, cheap plastic, overbloom, smoke obscuring the edges or background scenery. Cube occupies about 76 percent of square image width; no ground plane or baked backdrop; preserve alpha. Lighting from upper left, physically coherent perspective. Deliver a single standalone square item asset at high resolution.

Use case: precise-object-edit / production animation sprite sheet. Reference image 1 is the exact MIRACLE CUBE design to preserve: pearl-white gold structural cube, obsidian crystalline panels, faceted crystal corner locks, engraved circular diamond contract seal. Make a single transparent RGBA 4 columns by 2 rows animation sheet, eight equal SQUARE cells, reading left to right then next row. Overall aspect 2:1, 2048 by 1024 or higher equivalent. No margins between cells, NO drawn grid, borders, labels, text or background. In EACH cell, the artifact's center is exactly the cell center, SAME fixed three-quarter camera, angle, lighting, physical design and consistent scale. Closed cube occupies 55 percent of cell width; fully expanded cube never exceeds 90 percent, no part touches cell edges. Frame 1 closed exact reference. Frame 2 crystal corner locks twist mechanically outward and seams glow. Frame 3 face panels unlock and separate 5 percent exposing white core. Frame 4 the top face lifts upward while left and right faces hinge outward as RIGID metal plates, visible internal struts. Frame 5 face plates open halfway around a growing suspended prismatic light crystal. Frame 6 all six face panels fully separate like a mechanical artifact flower around the brilliant core, preserving the cube's identity. Frame 7 the internal core unfurls a compact flowing band of magical white/cyan/gold light while the solid open panels stay visible. Frame 8 the open cube remains at the same center, fully opened with a radiant compact core ready to reveal a collectible card. This must depict eight genuine distinct stages of physical opening, not a row of same closed cube with brightness variations. Perfect alpha transparency, restrained light extending only within each cell, polished detailed fantasy illustration matching reference, sharp luxurious gold-white-obsidian materials. Maintain consistent object size and camera across all frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide background illustration for a premium fantasy game mercenary cube-opening interface, 1536x1024 landscape. A restrained spectacular midnight contract vault, empty and unoccupied. Precisely crafted obsidian stone and blue-black brushed metal architecture, very fine champagne gold inlays, luminous pale turquoise mineral veins, a low circular dark marble summoning dais in the lower center with restrained concentric engraving. A high soft shaft of white-blue moonlight falls on EMPTY air above the dais where a separate game item will be composited. Distant tall dark arches recede symmetrically into shadow, suggestion of an immense ancient chamber, subtle atmospheric dust, a few dim suspended contract sigils far in the distance. High-end painterly semi-real fantasy game environment, sumptuous materials and convincing volume, strong purposeful composition, mostly deep navy black negative space with subtle gold highlights. Central 60 percent remains visually calm and uncluttered for cube and card reveal. Not a screenshot or UI mockup. No cube, no chest, no character, no card, no pedestal obstructing center, no text, no lettering, no HUD, no logo, no huge blown-out flares, no saturated purple fog. The result is an art-directed stage background for an actual working game interface, elegant and legible under white Korean UI.
